messages:
Maria (PM): Quick proposal — phased pilot for an Optimize Toolkit v1. Scope: lightweight Recommendations API (batching/caching/quant recs), Eval-triggered alerts (configurable), and minimal Ops/Admin controls. Aim: two pilots in ~8 weeks. Implementation emphasis: small config surface, per-tenant thresholds, clear rollback.

Aj (Eng): What are our acceptance criteria? perf SLAs and cost targets pls.

Maria (PM): Acceptance: p95 latency <= 1.2x baseline for common routes; target ~20% unit-cost reduction for pilot customers adopting recs; regression budget <= 5% visible errors in first 30 days.

Vikram (EngRuntime): Notes on runtime constraints: quant support varies by model family. Need an explicit fallback chain and a `quality_tier` arg (`high|medium|low`) so runtime picks quant/model variant. Proposal: default continuous batching window = 5ms (configurable per-route). Warning: aggressive batching on long contexts can spike mem usage.

Sana (DataSci): For eval-triggered alerts I propose metrics: concordance (top-k agreement), perplexity drift, generation rejection rate, and token-level hallucination proxy. Allow tenant-customized thresholds and lookback windows. Example YAML config: \n```\neval_alert:\n  name: "concordance_drop"\n  metric: "concordance"\n  threshold: 0.85\n  lookback: "7d"\n  notify: ["ops", "product"]\n  severity: "warning"\n  auto_action: "notify"\n```\nWe can run checks daily and wire alerts to notify + optional auto-rollback gates.

Jess (Design): UX needs: admin mute/unmute for noisy alerts, preview diffs showing recent metric trends, and a simple runbook link per alert. Also a compact historical chart per metric and a small inline CTA to rollback variant. I can mock a 2-panel admin view.

Maria (PM): Pilot customers: AcmeHealth (privacy-critical) and Notesly (SaaS textarea/editor). Rollback plan: auto-fallback to 'compat' variant, pause alerts, and an override to force previous quant+model. Figma mock posted to the team DM.

Aj (Eng): Rollout gating: tenant feature-flag + canary to 5% traffic, monitor 48h, expand to 25% then 100% if health checks pass. Need a perf test harness that mirrors pilot traffic profiles.

Vikram (EngRuntime): Agree. Telemetry contract: every request must include `rec_variant`, `quant_level`, `cache_hit`, and `eval_alerts_triggered` tags for attribution. Ops will use these for cost breakdown and fault triage.

ops-bot: Staging deploy scheduled at 1745560000 :robot_face:

Maria (PM): Action items: Aj — perf plan & harness (due Thu). Vikram — fallback chain + telemetry contract (due Mon). Sana — pilot eval thresholds + sample datasets (due Fri). Jess — admin UI mock + mute/preview flows (due Wed). I'll coordinate pilot invites and legal for AcmeHealth. :+1:

Aj (Eng): I'll sketch the SLA matrix and start load profiles today.

Vikram (EngRuntime): I'll prototype fallback POC and add `quality_tier` to the API draft.

Sana (DataSci): I'll prepare threshold recommendations and a small eval-runner for pilot datasets.

Jess (Design): Will share mocks by Wed EOD.

Maria (PM): One more note — for recommenders we should ship stateless suggestions first (batching/caching hints) and gate any model-change recs behind stronger opt-in and extra audit logs. Keeps risk low for AcmeHealth.
